== Links and stuff ==

Hey, great job on the re-write of the [[Wise One]] article. If you could, please take a look at the article now. I don't know if it is the browser you are using or if you are using an external editor or something, but something is kind of wonky with the links. It looks like you are formatting them like they are external links, (e.g. <nowiki>[http://wot.wikia.com/wiki/Wise_One Wise One]</nowiki> produces [http://wot.wikia.com/wiki/Wise_One Wise One]). Now, this wouldn't really be a problem, however it is kinda difficult when someone else tries to edit the article. Here is a quick breakdown on wikilinks.
*Normal link: <nowiki>[[Wise One]]</nowiki> looks like [[Wise One]]
*Making a link look like something else: <nowiki>[[Dreamwalking|Dreamwalk]]</nowiki> looks like [[Dreamwalking|Dreamwalk]]
Also, the curly apostrophe (’), if used in a link, won't link properly. Kind of look out for that. :) Hope I don't sound to over-bearing or anything. Again, great job on the re-write. Let me know if you have any questions. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 03:30, March 4, 2010 (UTC)
